exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance score ≤ 2.
a cardiovascular disability status of New York Heart Association Class ≥ 2
baseline prolongation of the heart rate-corrected QT (QTcF) interval ≥ 480 ms
congestive heart failure, myocardial infarction, stroke, or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months prior to the first dose of LP-118.
Known poorly controlled human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
Subjects with known and active central nervous system (CNS) involvement at Screening.
Subject has a history of other malignancies within past 12 months that are active and could result in competing risks.
A female subject is pregnant or breast-feeding.

Renal function criteria: Serum creatinine ≤ ULN (per local institution reference range) or Calculated creatinine clearance (Cr Cl) ≥ 60 mL/min using 24-hour CrCl OR by Cockcroft-Gault formula using actual body weight.
Hepatic function criteria: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 3.0 × ULN; bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN
